name: SEA Exhaust Gas Silencer
summary: Compact reactive/absorptive exhaust silencer for medium-speed diesel and petrol driven engines.
description: The SEA series silencer is a compact reactive/absorptive design silencer suitable for medium-speed diesel and petrol driven engines. The SEA range of silencers are suitable for dry marine applications as well as for standby generator sets and mobile applications. Based on a triple chamber design with low frequency noise being reduced in the first two chambers and the high frequency noise attenuated in the final absorption section. The SEA reactive absorptive range of silencers are of all welded design, constructed in carbon steel, finished with one coat heat resistant black paint to ensure a long service life.
options: BS10 Table ‘D’ flanges fitted as standard
Alternative flange patterns available on request
B.S.P. connections available on smaller sizes
Heat resisting aluminium or black paint
Shot blast and aluminium metal sprayed
